episodes.title: Another Bad Hombre
episodes.summary: In Mexico, a police unit tracks down a murderer as their police commander finds a dangerous lead. A new referendum introduces big changes.

episodes.title: Escape to Baja
episodes.summary: A heavy loss shakes up the Gringo Hunters as a new recruit enters the fold. A stakeout goes awry, and Temo's secrets begin to haunt Nico.

episodes.title: White Power
episodes.summary: Nico takes on Temo's debt as Gloria's date takes a turn. Terry discovers terrifying news. Joaquín makes good on his deal with Father Murphy.

episodes.title: I'm the Bait
episodes.summary: Nico confides in Gloria about Temo's gambling. The Gringo Hunters track a long-time criminal. Camila's first undercover case reveals hidden strings.

episodes.title: The American Dream
episodes.summary: The crew's new undercover case goes sideways. Terry seeks shelter with an old, powerful friend. A tip leads to Temo's potential murderer.

episodes.title: Nueva Tijuana
episodes.summary: Protests against New Tijuana erupt as Terry sets off on his own. A visit to Ortega tips Nico off. Finding Terry proves to be a fatal decision.

episodes.title: The Mexican Dream
episodes.summary: Nico and Gloria visit Father Murphy as Archi's search for a corrupt border patrol officer lands him in hot water. Ortega installs a new police chief.

episodes.title: What? Can't I Cry?
episodes.summary: With Archi missing, the Gringo Hunters lead a search party. Camila takes the reins on a case involving a sexual criminal. Gloria opens up to Emilio.

episodes.title: Test of Trust
episodes.summary: A new case affects Archi as a polygraph test bodes ill for Nico. A tip leads Gloria down a dark path, and threats against María and Silvia persist.

episodes.title: Lamb of God
episodes.summary: Nico fails Collado's test, and Gloria receives a promotion. As Archi faces a crisis, Nico and Gloria make a sordid discovery.

episodes.title: "Anybody call a cop?"
episodes.summary: Ortega takes a witness. Nico finds out more about Ortega's past. Camila treads a fine line as the squad crashes a crypto scammer's bridal shower.
Threats rise against the Gringo Hunters. An arrest sends Cartolandia into disarray, and one last piece of the puzzle falls.
